warnings.text:
Effect.Effect<Option.Option<A>, E, R> is TypeScript's spelling of an Effect type; write Option.Option<A>!E!R.
  Its quick fix writes Option.Option<A>!E!R; vibelang --fix applies every such fix in the project.

trustedPackages is deprecated and ignored; remove this retired option. Use a signature contract or an explicit Effect.try boundary for foreign calls.
